chunks: 1734 - And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Indeed, Allah, there is no deity but Him, surely wards off through charity illness, abscess, burning, drowning, collapse, and madness; and he, peace be upon him, enumerated seventy doors of evil."

key_terms.الدُّبَيْلَةَ: a serious internal abscess or swelling
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the One through whose power harm is repelled
key_terms.بِالصَّدَقَةِ: through charity; by means of giving in charity
key_terms.لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ: there is no deity but Him; an affirmation of tawhid

ai.seo_question: How does charity protect a person according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of ṣadaqah and its protective effects by Allah’s leave. It presents charity as a means through which many forms of harm and evil are repelled.
